name: Oor VII
description: Oor VII was a planet located within the Cronese Mandate, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. In ancient times, Oor VII was a humming factory world, but millennia of environmental degradation had left it parched and thinly populated. The planet was also known for its annual spelling bees.
